objective: TIPA ASSY Customer Demo Scenario v1 (contract_version=tipa-assy-demo-v1). Build a deterministic, resettable single-sub-line (ASSY-SL01) VF→MES demo: SSO2+RSO2 → PRE-ASSY → AP01..AP11 → LINE_OUT, with 4 deterministic WIPs (MTR-DEMO-001 happy good, MTR-DEMO-002 AP06 fail/retest/pass good, MTR-DEMO-003 AP05 jam fault→recover good, MTR-DEMO-004 terminal quality fail reject), independent line-state/exception/downtime/LINE_OUT/quality/genealogy events, and an OEE summary that reconciles (planned=run+downtime, actual=good+reject, A/P/Q). Route through the existing M5 pipeline (RealityInput → ObservationService → ObservationRouter → MESProjection → JSONL/MQTT gateways). Keep the accepted envelope; add minimal additive projection (mes.oee_summary + LINE_OUT execution_event). Add a minimal control surface (reset/start/pause/jam/recover) and contract fixtures. Do NOT redesign the simulation engine, observation pipeline, or MQTT gateway.
explicit_non_objectives: No new historian or OEE analytics platform
No redesign of the discrete simulation engine, observation pipeline core, or MQTT gateway
No change to frozen simulation/observation/gateway semantics
required_deliverables: src/virtual_factory/assembly/demo_assy_mes/ (scenario model, OEE, deterministic runner, M5 bridge, controller, fixtures)
required_tests: Topology ASSY-SL01 has PRE-ASSY + AP01..AP11 + LINE_OUT
Four deterministic WIPs produce the correct journeys (good/reject)
AP05 jam fault → STOPPED → RUNNING recovery
Reset leaves no runtime state; repeated run yields identical output/order
No duplicate events on retry (stable idempotency keys)
Existing VF test suite does not regress
forbidden_actions: Merge without SA authorization for the exact head SHA
stop_conditions: Redesign of the discrete engine, observation pipeline core, or MQTT gateway would be required
Required fixture/event cannot be produced deterministically

acceptance_criteria.description: Full test suite passes (deterministic scenario, 4 WIPs, fault/recovery, LINE_OUT, OEE, fixtures)
